caption: The drawing depicts two mechanical devices positioned side by side against a plain, off-white background. The object on the left is primarily light blue with silver accents and has ornate engraved patterns on its arms. It also features a large circular medallion with a flower-like design in the center and four small bolts securing it. The arms of this device curve downward symmetrically and end in hooks with triangular metal loops attached. The object on the right is a darker, metallic brown or black color with hints of rust, featuring simpler construction and fewer decorative elements. It has similar curved arms as the left object, but without ornate engravings, and also terminates with hooks at the bottom. Coiled ropes or cords loop through the top parts of both devices. The signature "HARRY MARIN WARDELL" is written near the lower right portion of the image.
